core_categories: Grocery Retail; Pharmacy; Convenience Stores; Fuel Stations
specialty_focus: Giant Eagle is a regional American supermarket chain operating grocery stores and pharmacies, along with upscale Market District stores and GetGo convenience stores. It serves as a one-stop-shop retailer for everyday essentials, health and wellness products, and specialty foods. It does not specialize in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Market District, GetGo, SUE BEE, Manhattan Associates, Ibotta, RangeMe, Grocery TV, others
